narr: Abundant moisture was drawn north across the region from the 14th into the 15th in advance of a slow moving cold front. Areas of heavy rain lifted north in advance of the front...enhanced by several lows lifting north along the slow moving front. The heaviest rains occurred from the overnight hours of the 14th into the morning of the 15th. Flash flooding developed in both the Bangor/Brewer and Lincoln/Mattawamkeag areas during the early morning hours of the 15th. Numerous roads were closed and impassable due to flash flooding...with vehicles also disabled. Water rescues were also required around Bangor/Brewer with up to 4 feet of standing water reported at some locations. Several roads were also closed in the Lincoln/Mattawamkeag area including Route 155 and Old Military Road. Old Military Road was partially collapsed due to rushing water overwhelming a culvert. Other roads and culverts were also damaged to varying extents across southern and central Penobscot county. Rainfall totals generally ranged from 2.50 to 4.50 inches...with local totals in excess of 5.00 inches.
